goal: Add unit tests for the notifications module and the admin module, and document the exported types in the TypeScript client.

plan.goal: Add pytest unit tests for the notifications and admin modules, and document the exported types in the TypeScript client.
plan.rationale: The notifications and admin modules lack dedicated unit coverage, while the TypeScript client's exported types need doc comments to clarify their public API surface.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for notifications module
tasks.instructions: Create tests/test_notifications.py with pytest unit tests covering the public functions and classes in src/notifications.py. Mock external dependencies and side effects. Follow existing pytest conventions used in tests/test_auth.py, tests/test_users.py, and tests/test_orders.py.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for admin module
tasks.instructions: Create tests/test_admin.py with pytest unit tests covering the public functions and classes in src/admin.py. Mock external dependencies and use pytest fixtures where appropriate. Follow existing pytest conventions used elsewhere in the tests directory.

tasks.title: Document exported TypeScript client types
tasks.instructions: Add JSDoc comments to every exported interface, type alias, and exported constant in src/client/types.ts. Include descriptions, property or member meanings, and concise examples where helpful. Do not alter runtime behavior or type definitions themselves.

results.notes: Created tests/test_notifications.py with pytest tests for the public send_email and send_sms functions in src/notifications.py. Tests follow the existing test conventions, mock the module logger to avoid side effects, verify return values, and assert expected logging calls. Only tests/test_notifications.py was changed; no source files were modified. git_diff returned no tracked diff, consistent with the new test file being untracked.

Created tests/test_admin.py via cursor-agent (single call) targeting the public API of src/admin.py: dashboard() and audit_log(). Conventions follow tests/test_orders.py and tests/test_users.py: top-level imports, plain test_* functions, and a local _make_valid_token() helper building a base64url JWT-like token with a future exp claim. External dependencies are mocked at the point of use (src.admin namespace) with pytest fixtures: mock_validate_token patching src.admin.validate_token and mock_check_permissions patching src.admin.check_permissions. Coverage: (1) test_dashboard_returns_metrics — asserts total_users=1000, total_orders=5000, revenue=250000.00, and that validate_token/check_permissions are each called once with the expected args ('admin', 'dashboard:read'); (2) test_dashboard_propagates_token_validation_error — validate_token raises ValueError('Invalid token'), error propagates and check_permissions is not called; (3) test_dashboard_propagates_permission_error — check_permissions raises after successful token validation; (4) test_audit_log_records_action — happy path asserting action/details/timestamp and that validate_token was called with the token; (5) test_audit_log_propagates_token_validation_error — invalid token raises and no result is returned. Unused imports in admin (get_user, create_order, charge, send_email) are not patched since dashboard()/audit_log() never invoke them. Note: git_diff returned empty output because tests/test_admin.py is a newly created, still-untracked file, so there is no tracked diff to display; the only path changed by this task was tests/test_admin.py (no other files modified). Verify with: python -m pytest tests/test_admin.py -q.

Added JSDoc comments to all six exported interfaces in src/client/types.ts: CreateOrderRequest, Order, ChargeRequest, ChargeResult, LoginRequest, and Session. Each has a descriptive block comment, per-property documentation, and concise examples where helpful. No exported type aliases or constants exist in the file. Only comments were added; type definitions, names, values, imports/exports, and runtime behavior were unchanged. git_diff confirms changes are limited to src/client/types.ts.
